summary: Universal Technical Institute Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new senior secured revolving credit facility with Fifth Third Bank as administrative agent and other lenders. The facility provides up to $200 million, with sublimits for swingline loans and letters of credit, plus $75 million uncommitted incremental capacity, maturing in August 2031. Borrowings bear floating interest at Term SOFR or Base Rate plus margins based on leverage. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; watch covenant compliance and utilization.
